title: Choose the locale scope deliberately
goal: Separate LANG, category overrides and LC_ALL; make one command deterministic without changing a login default.
challenge: A child command inherits LANG=de_DE.UTF-8 but LC_ALL=C. Demonstrate why its decimal point remains a dot. Supply a corrected one-command environment whose numeric category is German while machine processing remains explicit C elsewhere. Prove parent locale/default unchanged; do not edit system policy.

steps.command: w=$(mktemp -d "$HOME/foundation-locale-scope.XXXXXX") && cd "$w" && umask 077; here() { case "$w" in "$HOME"/foundation-locale-scope.??????) ;; *) return 19;; esac; test "${w%/*}" = "$HOME" && test -d "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && test "$(realpath -e "$w")" = "$w" && test "$(pwd -P)" = "$w" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a "$w")" = learner:700; }; fresh() { here && test "${1%/*}" = "$w" && test ! -e "$1" && test ! -L "$1"; }; regular() { here && test "${1%/*}" = "$w" && test -f "$1" && test ! -L "$1" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a:%h "$1")" = learner:600:1; }; here && test "$(df -B1 --output=avail / | tail -1)" -ge 1073741824 && pwd
steps.explanation: Record this unique guest-only workspace. On Resume re-establish the recorded path/definitions; never overwrite another exercise.
steps.expected: Private learner-owned700 directory and observed1GiB free admission.

steps.command: here && fresh "$w/parent.txt" && fresh "$w/default.sha" && locale > parent.txt && sha256sum /etc/locale.conf > default.sha && locale -a && locale charmap
steps.explanation: Record parent and system default before isolated command environments. Generated locales are real guest resources.

steps.command: here && fresh "$w/precedence.txt" && env LANG=de_DE.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C locale -k decimal_point > precedence.txt && grep -Fx 'decimal_point="."' precedence.txt && fresh "$w/category.txt" && env -u LC_ALL LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_NUMERIC=de_DE.UTF-8 locale -k decimal_point > category.txt && grep -Fx 'decimal_point=","' category.txt
steps.explanation: LC_ALL overrides LANG and category variables. Remove only the child override, then apply LC_NUMERIC deliberately.
steps.expected: Actual decimal point changes only in the selected child category.

steps.command: here && fresh "$w/after.txt" && locale > after.txt && cmp parent.txt after.txt && sha256sum -c default.sha
steps.explanation: Compare real parent environment and default bytes. A displayed language does not by itself establish persistence.

hints: LANG alone does not override LC_ALL; an unavailable locale is not a valid localized result.
Choose command scope deliberately; compare known bytes and actual statuses, not only a successful-looking display.
Retain before evidence; refuse collisions and restore exact policy state before leaving. Guest root can bypass guest-side guards.
review: I demonstrated the selected mode’s actual observations and retained an incorrect or incomplete case.
I preserved originals and can explain the reasoning and limitations; this records self-review, not automatic assessment.
I restored any changed default/zone and retained the exact workspace without touching unrelated files.
coverage: LPIC-1 active v5.0 partial 107.3 locale environment; 103.1 variables: reinforcement. No complete-objective coverage or endorsement.
